title: Among Us: Measuring and Mitigating Malicious Contributions in Model Collaboration Systems
findings: This paper does not analyze any aspect of religion or faith. Its focus is on the impact of malicious models in collaborative multi-LLM systems across safety, reasoning, knowledge, coding, and instruction-following domains.
